description: This file defines the interface for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory class, which provides factory methods to create and access singleton instances related to media keys capabilities for IPC in the Rialto client component.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class for obtaining instances of IMediaKeysCapabilities for IPC communication.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create and retrieve a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get the singleton IMediaKeysCapabilities instance for IPC.
